name: dca-craft
description: Craft skills and agents independent of the architecture style: Test-Driven Development, Clean Code while writing, Architecture Decision Records, end-user browser tests (Page Objects, stable selectors, setting up a browser runner), a maintainable web frontend (design principles, one owner per style, tokens in three tiers with a theme, scales with floors, intrinsic layouts and container queries, components with a contract, WCAG 2.2 AA, a living gallery with fixtures), the Ubiquitous Language glossary and the strategic context map, product discovery (a problem, its evidence and an observable outcome, with cited sources), and three review perspectives with the familiar names — review-ddd, review-hexagonal, review-clean-code — plus thin reviewer and E2E agents around them. An outside view: it reads what any project has — code, glossary, context map, AGENTS.md — and names no DCA artifact. Pairs with dca-core, which adds the DCA method.
